From: Claire Jansen <claire.jansen@globex.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Uptime & RTO/RPO evidence for procurement review

Hi Grace,

We are preparing Globex Financial's third-party risk assessment and procurement team has asked for BCP/DR evidence to close our integration review. Can you share the following by EOD next week?

- Current RTO and RPO attestation for the hosted API and dedicated deployments (numbers and last test date)
- Short summary of the most recent disaster recovery test (scope, failover time observed, gaps)
- The recovery runbook or playbook you would share for a production failover (redacted where needed)
- Contact for a 1-hour technical walkthrough the week of Sep 6–10

If there are standard artifacts (SOC 2 Type II report, DR test summary CSV, runbook pdf) please link or attach. We are also collecting a signed attestation for our vendor file — if you have a template we can exchange for signature that works.

Thanks,
Claire Jansen
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Globex Financial
security@globex.com

Attachments requested: RTO_RPO_attestation_template.docx (optional)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com>

Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Uptime & RTO/RPO evidence for procurement review

Claire — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Markus (Head of Infra) and Monica (Security) to gather the artifacts. Preliminary answers below; we will follow up with attachments and a walkthrough time.

Quick summary (high level):
- Current committed RTO (hosted API): 4 hours for critical services; RPO: 15 minutes for customer-facing data (KV cache + WAL-backed storage).
- Dedicated deployments: customer-configurable, typical committed baseline 2–6 hours depending on SLA tier; default RPO 15–30 minutes.
- Last full DR test (multi-region failover) completed: 2026-07-10 — observed failover ~3h45m to full API health for the simulated region-loss scenario.

Planned deliverables by Sep 2:
- Redacted recovery playbook (PDF) — will include failover steps, runbook owner contacts, and rollback criteria.
- DR test summary CSV with timestamps and measured RTO/RPO (we ran canary + full failover).
- SOC 2 Type II cover page and pointer to our SOC report download (we host under secure link).
- Suggested 1-hour walkthrough slots for Sep 6–10 (please indicate preferred days/times).

We will also fill your attestation template if you send it — otherwise we can provide our vendor attestation doc for signature.

Regards,
Grace O'Connor
Head, Customer Security & Compliance (interfacing)
Redwood Inference

--
Grace O'Connor
redwood.example.com

(Attachment stubs referenced: playbook_placeholder.pdf, rto_rpo_summary_placeholder.csv)

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 14:27:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: DR test artifacts and notes

Grace/Monica — I pulled the artifacts for Globex. Notes below; will attach the sanitized runbook and the CSV summary to Grace before external send.

Summary notes from 2026-07-10 multi-region failover:
- Scenario: simulated primary region outage for PRD-OR1 (full control-plane failover to PRD-US2).
- Observed timeline:
  - 00:00 trigger (failover start)
  - 00:22 fire signal and route switch in control-plane
  - 01:10 infra bootstrapping and model cache warmup begins
  - 03:45 API health checks green across core endpoints (full traffic verified)
- Root cause gaps called out: transient KV cache warmup led to added latency for long-running sessions; we added pre-warm hooks and improved KV sync for the next run.
- RPO measured for customer data streams: between 5–15 minutes depending on workload; critical write paths maintained WAL and cross-region replication.

Attachments I will provide: ops-runbook-notes.md (redacted), rto-rpo-test-summary-20260710.csv. I also confirm SOC evidence is up-to-date (SOC 2 Type II report issued 2025) — Monica will confirm link and access controls.

-Markus
